title: Plans after returning home and starting a brass band
summary: He expects to teach, study and perhaps start a brass band, and says playing with the Eureka taught him slower tempos.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: Uh, when you go back, when you go back home, Joe, are you going to teach?

Yeah. Probably. I want to also do a bit of studying on my own, you know, mark time without having the pressure on. Yeah. And I want to play a little too, I suppose. Of course, I don't know what the situation is over there. It's three years since I've been there. It might be so much that everybody's fed up with it or, I don't know, I have an idea that might be. On the other hand, I might be able to, to play. I'd like to start a brass band if they got one brass band, I mean, I think another one could help. Sure, they got several here, whatever.
Sure. They have a couple or three there.
And I've played with the Eureka over here. Learned a little bit about it. I mean, they used to play slowly, much slowly. Yeah.
